note: Hand-curated static catalog. Only techniques supported by current rule telemetry. AUTH-002 and NET-002 deliberately unmapped.

techniques.description: Adversaries may use brute force to gain access to accounts when passwords are unknown or hashes are obtained.
techniques.name: Brute Force

techniques.description: Adversaries may steal valid credentials and use them to gain Initial Access, persist, or escalate privilege within a network.
techniques.name: Valid Accounts

techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.
techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter

techniques.description: Adversaries may use obfuscated files or information to hide artifacts of an intrusion from analysis.
techniques.name: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information

techniques.description: Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over a different protocol than the existing command and control channel.
techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol

techniques.description: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols to avoid detection by blending in with existing traffic.
techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
